resources.string: Thank you for choosing\nCS Launcher Plus!
Your launcher is ready. Here is everything you need to know before you play.
You can reopen this from Settings → About at any time.

Your launcher is ready. Here is everything you need to know before you play:

• ACCOUNTS — sign in with Microsoft, Ely.by, or play offline.
• PROFILES — every Minecraft version from 1.8 to 1.21+, plus Forge, Fabric, Quilt, OptiFine and full modpacks.
• PERFORMANCE — Normal, Performance or Maximum from Settings.
• CONTROLS — fully customizable on-screen buttons and joystick.
• UPDATES — the launcher updates itself in-app.
Sign in with Microsoft or Ely.by, or play offline. Switch accounts from the chip at the top of Home.
Every Minecraft version from 1.8 to 1.21+, plus Forge, Fabric, Quilt, OptiFine and full modpacks. Default: 1.21.11 Vanilla.
Pick Normal, Performance or Maximum in Settings. Maximum unlocks the highest FPS your phone can safely hold.
Fully customizable on-screen buttons, joystick and custom commands — open Control Customization from the left dock.
The launcher updates itself in-app; you will be told the moment a new release lands.
